alignmentNotes.frozenGis2dMaterials: All GIS_<area> 2D floor materials in standards/floor-types.json and standards/color_theme.json stay frozen and untouched.
alignmentNotes.tiles3dPaletteResolver: Tiles3DMaterialPaletteResolver passes K3D_* and M3D_* materials through verbatim under Source, KanizuSoft, KanizuWhite, and KanizuFull palettes while remapping GIS_<area> floor colors.
alignmentNotes.srgbAndGlTF: srgb values are authored as 0-255 sRGB bytes for Revit Material.Color; Tiles3DGlbWriter converts Kanizu palette colors to linear-light baseColorFactor.
alignmentNotes.glazingStrategy: Prefer opaque recessed glazing (K3D_Glass_Opaque, transparency=0) on recessed door/elevator panes to avoid glTF BLEND depth-sorting artifacts; reserve translucent glazing (K3D_Glass, M3D_GlassGuard) for balustrades and frameless guards.
